I work at the [California Air Resources Board](https://ww2.arb.ca.gov/). Before that, I was an instructional designer at [UC Berkeley School of Public Health](https://publichealth.berkeley.edu/). 

In 2021, I graduated from Berkeley Public Health with a master’s degree in global health and environment. In 2017, I earned my BS in environmental science with a software engineering minor from [Rochester Institute of Technology](https://www.rit.edu/science/).
